vale_house_winter.description: The same Stardew Valley building in winter: a thick, even layer of fresh white snow on every roof plane and the roof ridges, snow on the window sills and the top of the chimney, icicles along the eaves; walls, doors, windows and everything else exactly as they are. Keep the shape and every outline identical.
